name: hud_ui_mgr_apply_hud_mode_switch
description: HudUiMgr::ApplyHudModeSwitch returns the current HUD type and switches to the standard or perspective HUD layout when layouts are initialized.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this helper remains deferred to a coherent HUD manager/source-cluster tier S pass.
Binary Ninja still renders the chained dec/test case for HUD type 2 as a raw enum value in decompilation; assembly confirms the branch target and source keeps the source-level type value.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4136b0 validates saving the current zOpt HUD type, checking g_HudUiMgrHudLayoutsInitialized, switching to g_HudLayoutSW for input 1, switching to g_HudLayoutHW for input 2, ignoring other values, and returning the saved current type.

The native smoke verifies the uninitialized no-switch path, initialized standard and perspective layout switches through HudUiMgr::SwitchActiveDialog, ignored mode values, and the return value for software and hardware HUD type options.
